name: em_furniture_and_interior
description: EM Furniture and Interior - E-commerce Web Application (MVP)

scripts.dev: npm run dev -w apps/api & npm run dev -w apps/storefront
scripts.test: npm test -w apps/api && npm test -w apps/storefront
scripts.test:visual: npm run build -w apps/storefront && playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.js visual.spec.js
scripts.test:visual:update: npm run build -w apps/storefront && playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.js visual.spec.js --update-snapshots=all
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build -w apps/storefront && playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.js
